Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, this film transports viewers to 1870s South India, where Vijay embodies a courageous warrior standing up to a British commissioner to safeguard his homeland. Alongside him is Rashmika Mandanna, portraying his fiery wife who's equally committed to the fight.

items.title: Rashmika Mandanna says she still feels like a fangirl of husband Vijay
items.body: <![CDATA[Rashmika Mandanna attended the pre-release event for their upcoming film 'Ranabaali' alongside her husband Vijay Deverakonda. She shared her excitement about watching his performance in the film, feeling like a fangirl. Rashmika emphasized the significance of 'Ranabaali' for both her and Vijay as it showcases their partnership in a rebellion. The film features Hollywood actor Arnold Vosloo as the antagonist and is set to release on October 16, 2026.

items.title: Lalit Modi claims Disney turned down financing 'Ramayan' after THIS
items.body: <![CDATA[Lalit Modi recounted an intriguing tale about how Disney turned down funding for Ramanand Sagar's Ramayan, citing cultural mismatches, particularly Sagar's attire during the pitch. Despite Modi's persuasion, the executives didn't connect. The beloved series eventually found a home on Doordarshan, transforming the landscape of Indian television and popularizing the mythological genre significantly.

items.title: Vidya on being labelled a 'jinx' in South cinema: 'I was replaced even before..'
items.body: <![CDATA[In the eagerly anticipated film 'Jailer 2', Vidya Balan will star alongside the legendary Rajinikanth. Reflecting on her journey, she recounted the challenging times in her early career when she was unfairly branded a 'jinx' in South cinema, which made her hesitant about pursuing those roles. Now, with a focus on timing, she recognizes the importance of quality roles for an actor's success.

items.title: Inside Madhuri, Dr Nene's 5500 sq feet home in Worli with more than 30 MF Hussain art pieces
items.body: <![CDATA[In a magnificent Mumbai apartment on the 53rd floor, Madhuri Dixit and Dr Shriram Nene immerse themselves in luxury surrounded by an extraordinary collection of over 30 paintings by MF Husain. Dedicated spaces within their home commemorate Madhuri's professional success and their shared journey. The living area, elegantly divided for family bonding and social gatherings, radiates warmth and style through its carefully curated lighting and decor.

items.title: 'Nana Patekar took Rs 1 more than Bachchan to work with him,' recalls 'Drishyam 3' actor
items.body: <![CDATA[Drishyam 3 actor Kamlesh Sawant expressed his sorrow over Nana Patekar's demise, sharing anecdotes about his remarkable career. He highlighted an instance where Patekar allegedly requested Rs 1 more than Amitabh Bachchan's fee. Sawant credited Patekar with revolutionizing dialogue delivery in Bollywood, which engaged audiences more than music during that time. Additionally, he acknowledged Patekar’s work through the NAAM Foundation to improve water access in Maharashtra.

items.title: Salman Khan on why he doesn’t discuss relationships: 'Person goes and gets married to somebody else'
items.body: <![CDATA[In the debut episode of Koffee With Karan season 9, Salman Khan opened up about personal facets of his life. He clarified his previous comments regarding virginity, citing a strong wish for privacy. While touching on themes of solitude, he mentioned a sense of fulfillment without a partner and expressed hope for fatherhood in the future, praising Karan Johar's surrogacy experience. Future episodes promise exciting celebrity discussions.

items.title: Vijay Deverakonda calls Rashmika Mandanna his ‘favourite co-star’
items.body: <![CDATA[During a recent pre-release event, Vijay Deverakonda proudly acknowledged the remarkable growth of Rashmika Mandanna as an actress. He affectionately referred to her as his favorite co-star, highlighting their strong professional chemistry. They also discussed their collaboration in their upcoming film, ‘Ranabaali’, slated for release on October 16, 2026, where Rashmika takes on a central role while Vijay portrays a valiant Rayalaseema warrior.

items.title: Nana Patekar prayer meet: Shivaji Satam, Rohini Hattangadi, others pay tribute
items.body: <![CDATA[On October 8, 2026, Indian cinema mourned the loss of legendary actor Nana Patekar at the age of 75. His passing was marked by a ceremonial funeral with state honors, surrounded by family, friends, and fans who revered him. A special prayer gathering, 'Aathvanilya Nana', was held to reflect on his remarkable influence on both cinema and theatre. Read on.

items.title: 'Ranveer had to control his energy in Dhurandhar, but he was so secure,' says Salman
items.body: <![CDATA[Salman Khan made headlines by appearing on the first episode of 'Koffee With Karan' season 9, which debuted on October 14. In a lively discussion, he complimented Ranveer Singh for his role in 'Dhurandhar', showcasing their differing approaches to acting. Salman also reflected on his choice to keep personal matters private, influenced by his father's advice on handling public interest in relationships.

items.title: Namit Malhotra announces global promotions for Ranbir's 'Ramayana'
items.body: <![CDATA[Namit Malhotra, the producer, has announced that the global promotional effort for 'Ramayana' will commence tomorrow, with Sony Pictures at the helm. With a release date set for November 5, 2026, coinciding with Diwali, the film boasts an impressive cast, including Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. The campaign specifically targets international viewers, ensuring the story resonates worldwide before its release.

items.title: Russell Brand called a ‘ruthless’ sexual predator as trial begins in London
items.body: <![CDATA[Russell Brand has pleaded not guilty as his rape and sexual assault trial began at Southwark Crown Court in London. The 51-year-old comedian faces seven charges involving six women, including three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. A prosecutor described him as a “ruthless” sexual predator.

items.title: Salman Khan opens up about being in a bad shape after 'Sultan'
items.body: <![CDATA[In a candid conversation on 'Koffee With Karan', Salman Khan shared his fitness journey at the age of 61, highlighting how discipline and lifestyle adjustments have helped him navigate health hurdles and injuries. He reflected on how these challenges affected his physicality over time. With exciting projects like 'Mathrubhumi' and 'Monster' on the horizon, Khan continues to host 'Bigg Boss 20' and seeks future superhero collaborations.

items.title: Sonu Nigam’s October 24 Bengaluru concert in trouble as KRV warns of statewide protests
items.body: <![CDATA[The Karnataka Rakshana Vedike has formally urged the Bengaluru City Police to cancel Sonu Nigam's upcoming concert due to contentious remarks he made last year that they believe disrespected Kannada culture. They warn that permitting the event might inflame public sentiment, leading to widespread protests. Specific demands regarding their grievances have been outlined, and ignoring these could escalate tensions statewide.

items.title: Varsha Usgaonkar mourn's Nana Patekar’s demise: 'If he had gotten necessary medical help...'
items.body: <![CDATA[Varsha Usgaonkar expressed deep sadness over Nana Patekar's passing, believing that prompt medical intervention might have altered the outcome. She reminisced about her experience working alongside him in 'Tirangaa,' cherishing his remarkable range as an actor across different genres. After his fatal cardiac arrest, a post-mortem confirmed no suspicious circumstances, and his last rites were honored with full state recognition at his Pune farmhouse.

items.title: Matthew spent two days in a West Texas desert reading 20 years of bad reviews
items.body: <![CDATA[Oscar-winning actor Matthew McConaughey, 56, spent two days in the West Texas desert reading 20 years of negative reviews. The $200 million star said the exercise helped him distinguish personal attacks from constructive criticism. Reflecting on his Hollywood journey, McConaughey explained how honest feedback can reveal weaknesses and help actors improve their performances.

items.title: Kelly Clarkson 'put us in danger,' claims Brooklyn shop owner
items.body: <![CDATA[Kelly Clarkson's dispute with Brooklyn's Art of Play over a $15,000 mechanical singing bird has escalated. Co-owner Adam Rubin claims the singer's public comments have put the shop in danger, alleging threats against people associated with the business. Meanwhile, the automaton, named Molly, now carries a $15 million price tag, despite the shop maintaining it is not for sale.

items.body: <![CDATA[In a proactive measure, the Madras High Court has ordered a prohibition against illegal online streaming of the much-anticipated film 'Jailer 2', set to release on October 15. This order follows a petition by Sun Pictures to shield their theatrical earnings from piracy threats. Starring the iconic Rajinikanth and backed by a substantial budget, the ruling underscores the importance of protecting commercial interests in cinema.

items.title: Aishwarya’s young co-star Namah Singh Deewana shares BTS pictures
items.body: <![CDATA[Child actor Namah Singh Deewana recently shared behind-the-scenes moments from an advertising shoot with Aishwarya Rai Bachchan. He expressed excitement about meeting the actress and described the experience as a dream come true. Namah praised Aishwarya for her beauty and kindness during their interaction on set. He also emphasized how memorable the day was and how it left a significant impact on him.

items.title: Kiran Rao wants to remake Korean drama 'Reply 1988'
items.body: <![CDATA[Filmmaker Kiran Rao has shown a desire to adapt the South Korean drama 'Reply 1988' for an Indian audience. She appreciates the storytelling and the focus on both younger and older characters in the series. Rao identifies similarities between the neighborhood in the show and the concept of para in Kolkata. While there is no confirmation of a remake yet, she highlights the show's cultural relevance.

items.title: CCTV footage of Kelly Clarkson at store fuels debate - WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[Kelly Clarkson experienced a controversial shopping trip at Art of Play, a store in Brooklyn. Following her visit, she took to X to express dissatisfaction with the treatment she received. The store responded by clarifying that a specific item she inquired about was not for sale. Both Clarkson's and the store's accounts have sparked significant online discussion regarding customer treatment.

items.title: When Nana Patekar told Anil Kapoor, ‘You have bullied me a lot in 'Parinda'’
items.body: <![CDATA[Nana Patekar and Anil Kapoor recently recalled their experiences during the promotion of 'Vanvaas'. They discussed Patekar's disappointment about the casting of Jackie Shroff in 'Parinda'. Anil Kapoor clarified his reasoning behind suggesting Shroff for the role. Despite the initial setback, Patekar appreciated the role he ultimately received as Anna. An emotional farewell was extended to Patekar by friends, colleagues, and government officials at his funeral.

items.title: Anirudh seeks blessings at Tiruvannamalai ahead of 'Jailer 2' release
items.body: <![CDATA[In anticipation of 'Jailer 2' set to release on October 15, Anirudh Ravichander paid a heartfelt visit to the Annamalaiyar Temple to offer prayers. His sincere devotions were aimed at bestowing blessings on the film featuring legendary actor Rajinikanth. The event sparked a buzz on social media, showcasing Anirudh's engaging interactions with fans. This collaboration marks another noteworthy moment in his successful musical journey in Tamil cinema.

items.title: Koffee With Karan 9 premiere: When and where to stream Salman Khan episode
items.body: <![CDATA[‘Koffee With Karan 9’ premieres on JioHotstar on October 14, 2026, at 7 pm IST, with Salman Khan opening the final season. After 22 years, eight seasons and 161 episodes, host Karan Johar is bringing his celebrity chat show to an end. The premiere promos feature Salman’s playful exchanges with Johar, including his response, “Control bro,” to a personal question. Here’s where to watch the final season and why the show is signing off.

items.title: ‘Diary’ director Innasi Pandian gets support after loss claim
items.body: <![CDATA[Tiruppur Subramaniam shed light on the financial dilemmas faced by producers due to decisions made by directors, igniting a debate over the accountability of filmmakers. Innasi Pandian and Ajay Gnanamuthu raised concerns about these assertions, with Gnanamuthu urging that accusations should be backed by concrete evidence. This discussion underscores the critical need for transparency and responsibility within the film industry.

items.title: Drishyam 3 writer reveals 20 climax versions were written to surprise fans
items.body: <![CDATA[‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’ has crossed Rs 500 crore worldwide, with co-writer Aamil Keeyan Khan revealing that the team developed 15-20 versions of the ending to surprise audiences. In an interview with Mid-Day, Khan discussed the seven-day rewrite after Akshaye Khanna’s exit, Jaideep Ahlawat’s character and the debate over Ajay Devgn’s Vijay Salgaonkar becoming darker. With respect to its box office performance, the film toppled the Rs 500 crore worldwide gross milestone on Day 12 of its theatrical run.

items.title: 'Drishyam 3' BO Day 13 [LIVE]: Ajay Devgn thriller eyes Rs 350 crore India net
items.body: <![CDATA[The Vijay Salgaonkar saga is delivering a masterclass in box office sustainability. Entering its second Wednesday, Abhishek Pathak's Drishyam 3: The Conclusion maintains an impressive grip over moviegoers across urban centers and mass belts alike. After storming through its opening week and recording an extraordinary second weekend jump, the Ajay Devgn-starrer has breached major commercial thresholds both at home and abroad. As real-time occupancy stays consistent on Day 13, the film can comfortably propel its domestic earnings toward the coveted Rs 350 crore mark before the close of its third week.

items.title: ‘The Raja Saab’ maker on Prabhas starrer film failure
items.body: <![CDATA[Prabhas' latest film, 'The Raja Saab,' struggled to perform well at the box office, falling short of expectations with mixed reviews. Producer TG Vishwa Prasad suggested that the timing of the release during Sankranthi played a significant role in this outcome. Additionally, the rise in ticket prices and delays in premieres disappointed fans. Despite a production budget exceeding Rs 400 crore, the film managed to earn only Rs 208.

Piane's contributions included music for multiple seasons of 'RuPaul's Drag Race' and collaborations with RuPaul. The threats came after his criticism of the protests organized by CJP and his views on political expression. Shorey tagged Maharashtra Cyber in his social media post requesting attention to his case.

The director expressed deep gratitude for the recognition, emphasizing how much it meant to him. Raja fondly reminisced about how Sivakarthikeyan played a pivotal role in fueling his cinematic dreams.
